paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: Evaluation of our models and LLaMA-3-8B-inst.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks" illustrates the performance scores of two models across various datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis labeled "Dataset and Metrics" displays the categories labeled as GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, in no particular sorted order. The vertical axis represents the "Score (%)" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, marked at intervals of 10%. Each category features two bars differentiated by color, with a legend identifying the blue bars as "LLaMA-3-8B-it" and the orange bars as "Ours (Iterative RLHF)". The approximate scores vary across categories, with GSM-8K having bars around 80% for both models, followed by MMLU having both bars at around 65%, followed by HumanEval, where LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue) bar is at 60% while Ours (Iterative RLHF) (orange) bar is at 63%. This is followed by TruthfulQA, where the blue bar is around 45% and the orange bar is at 60%, followed by ARC and MBPP, where both bars are 60%. For LC AlpacaEval-2, the blue bar is at 25% while the orange bar is at 30%. For MT-Bench (x5), both bars are around 40%. While Chat-Arena-Hard scores are among the lowest, below 30%. HumanEval and ARC reach close to 60%, and TruthfulQA, MT-Bench (×5) show notable differences in scores between the models. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their assigned colors. There is a legend on the top right that matches the bar colors to their models.
